referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset is designed to adjust resource demand in multi-output processes with mixed allocation schemes for resources (physical) and others (economical). In cases where the the upstream concentrate-inventory is allocated by economic criterias, the resouce demand of the individual refernece flos does not reflect the physical reality. Therefore the resource allocation is adjusted using this dataset in a way, that the resource demand of the specific reference flows from the multi-output process reflect the effective material composition .; UUID: 093752ee-a3e2-37d2-a94c-b184eff3310b
